name: searchTerm
label: Search Term
help: Keyword or phrase to search. If omitted, starts from a broad jobs search and applies the filters.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Number of search results to return (max 1000)

name: customSearchUrl
label: Custom Search URL
help: URL copied from a LinkedIn jobs search page after configuring desired filters. When specified, overrides term and filter parameters.

name: location
label: Location
help: Free-form location to filter by (e.g., San Francisco, California, United States)

name: datePosted
label: Date Posted
help: Filter by when the job was posted

name: companies
label: Companies
help: Company names to filter by (e.g., Google, Microsoft)

name: industries
label: Industries
help: Industries to filter by (e.g., Software Development, Technology)

name: jobFunctions
label: Job Functions
help: Job functions to filter by (e.g., Engineering, Product Management)

name: easyApply
label: Easy Apply
help: When enabled, only returns jobs with Easy Apply

name: hasVerifications
label: Has Verifications
help: When enabled, only returns jobs with verification signals

name: under10Applicants
label: Under 10 Applicants
help: When enabled, only returns jobs with fewer than 10 applicants

name: inYourNetwork
label: In Your Network
help: When enabled, only returns jobs from your network

name: fairChanceEmployer
label: Fair Chance Employer
help: When enabled, only returns fair chance employer jobs
